commits.message:
Add bracket-key roof plane step-through for 3D review

] selects the next roof plane and [ the previous one, wrapping at both
ends, so reviewers can walk a whole roof without leaving the keyboard.

stepRoofPlaneSelection is the pure walk math; useRoofPlaneStep3D listens
at the page level through useSceneElementEventListener, skips text
fields and contenteditable targets, and only acts while the 3D editor
owns the keyboard. Wiring into the editor tree is a follow-up ticket.

preregistration.amendment: Keyboard-boundary slate: seven paired lanes on one ratified task, run in the order gpt-5.6-luna, deepseek-v4-pro-0813, qwen3.8-max, deepseek-v4-flash-0731, gpt-5.6-terra, k3, gpt-5.6-sol. The first four are the fast slate; the last three run only if the machine reaches them before the deterministic evasion pass finishes, and any lane not reached is reported as not-dispatched rather than as an outcome. Width is two concurrent lanes while the one-minute load average is under 8, runs stay back-to-back within a lane, the timeout is 1800 seconds, and one-minute load samples are recorded for every run. The helper-family axis belongs to the earlier duplicate-implementation task and does not apply here; it is held constant at 'both' across every lane and no result is reported by it.
